May 14, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Vaughan Nelson Investment Management Lp increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 2.31% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vaughan Nelson Investment Management Lp bought 28,267 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.25M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $107.13 million, up from 1.22 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vaughan Nelson Investment Management Lp who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $754.64 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.52 $98.22. About 3.25M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Hilton Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 15.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hilton Capital Management Llc sold 3,001 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 15,925 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.70 million, down from 18,926 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hilton Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $925.91B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.21 $188.38. About 3.57 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Since February 16, 2018, it had 0 insider purchases, and 3 insider sales for $930,912 activity.
